logic.model_loading: Base model directly when adapter is absent; otherwise merge the LoRA adapter into a temporary full model, then load it with vLLM.
logic.prompt: Use each dataset row's stored prompt and apply the model chat template; the dataset mode determines Label-only versus CoT instructions.
logic.decoding: Greedy decoding with temperature=0 and top_p=1.
logic.prediction: Parse the last <score> integer in the allowed score set; missing or out-of-range scores are invalid and count as incorrect.
logic.metrics: Accuracy, macro-F1, per-class metrics, format-valid rate, confusion matrix, token statistics, and MAE/QWK for ordinal score sets.
